prompts.title: Urban Eclipse
prompts.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic cinematic night portrait of a man seated confidently on a large dark stone block in a modern city skyline. He has a neatly styled, well-groomed appearance, wearing an oversized navy blue sweatshirt, gray cargo pants, white sneakers, and a black smartwatch. He sits with legs spread naturally, both hand relaxed between his legs, looking directly at the camera with a calm, confident expression. A massive detailed full moon is perfectly positioned behind his head, creating a dramatic silhouette effect. Tall illuminated skyscrapers rise on both sides in the background, deep navy blue night sky, wet reflective ground, moody urban atmosphere, cinematic lighting, realistic skin and fabric textures, dramatic low-angle composition, eye-level subject gaze, centered framing, shallow depth of field, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, 8K resolution, 85mm lens, f/1.6, cinematic color grading. Aspect ratio 4:5.

prompts.title: Aesthetic Couple Wallpaper
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic iOS-style lockscreen wallpaper featuring the uploaded couple as the main characters. Use the uploaded image strictly for face and identity reference. Preserve both people’s exact facial features, face shape, skin tone, hairstyle, expressions, and overall identity without changing them.
Composition: trendy fashion-campaign portrait of the couple shot from an extreme low-angle ground perspective, as if the camera is placed near the floor looking upward. Both subjects stand confidently in stylish matching outfits with clean white sneakers. Keep the pose natural, confident, and premium. Background should be a bright clear blue sky with vibrant daylight and natural shadows.
Add playful Pinterest-style graphic elements around the couple: colorful doodle flowers, sketch stars, sparkles, hearts, small sticker graphics, and hand-drawn accents. Add a clean yellow dashed outline surrounding both people together. Near the upper clock area, add tiny cute chibi versions of the same couple as decorative mini stickers.
Overlay a realistic premium smartphone lockscreen UI: Dynamic Island at the top, small lock icon, large clean clock showing 09:41, date text Friday, June 5, battery indicator, small weather widget, and realistic soft notification cards near the lower area. Keep the UI elegant, minimal, readable, and Apple-keynote inspired.
Style: luxury lifestyle photography, ultra-realistic skin texture, photorealistic lighting, vibrant colors, sharp details, premium wallpaper quality, clean high-end mobile lockscreen design. Vertical 9:16 phone wallpaper ratio, ultra-sharp, 8K detail, polished Pinterest aesthetic.
